name: comp_vocal_bg
description: Backing vocal — 3:1 gentle leveling, slower than lead so the BG sits naturally behind without competing for the listener's focus
notes: 10 ms attack — slow enough to let onsets through gently. 150 ms release — long enough to feel passive in the mix. +4 dB makeup. Use heavier comp (5:1) if the BG layer is too inconsistent in level.
